info.title: QuantifyPro API
info.description: QuantifyPro Backend REST API. All responses follow a consistent envelope format with `success`, `message`, `data`, and `timestamp` fields. Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT token in the Authorization header.

tags.name: BIM / BOQ Pipeline
tags.description:
Autodesk Platform Services (APS) + Claude AI pipeline for reading CAD/BIM
building plans and generating a professional Bill of Quantities (BOQ).

**Three-step flow:**
1. `POST /upload`       — Upload a CAD/BIM file; APS returns a URN and starts SVF2 translation.
2. `GET /status/:urn`   — Poll until `status === "success"` (typically 30 s – 5 min).
3. `POST /boq/:urn`     — Extract element properties, clean them, and send to Claude for BOQ generation.

**Supported formats:** RVT (Revit), DWG, DXF, IFC, NWD, PDF (vector), DGN, SKP, OBJ, FBX.

**Note:** PDF "scanned" drawings (raster images) will not contain BIM properties and may produce
empty BOQs — only vector/intelligent PDFs carry extractable element data.

post.description: Admin endpoint to allocate, refund, or bonus credits to a user's account.

Creates a new user account with the provided details. Passwords are hashed using bcrypt
before storage. On success, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the user's email address for
verification. **No auth tokens are returned** — the user must verify their email first
via the `/verify-email` endpoint. If the role is `company`, the `companyName` field is required.

201.description: Registration successful — OTP sent to the provided email for verification.

data.message: OTP sent to your email address

400.description: Validation failed — one or more fields are invalid.

post.description:
Verifies a user's email address using the 6-digit OTP sent during registration.
On success, the user's `emailVerified` flag is set to `true`, all existing OTPs
are invalidated, and JWT access and refresh tokens are returned so the user is
immediately logged in.

The OTP expires after **15 minutes**. If it has expired, use the
`/resend-otp` endpoint to request a new one.

otp.description: The 6-digit verification code sent to the email.

200.description: Email verified — returns user profile and JWT tokens.

400.description: Validation failed — invalid email or OTP format.

401.description: Unauthorized — OTP is invalid or expired.

404.description: Not found — no user with the given email.

post.description:
Invalidates any previously issued OTP for the given email and sends a fresh
6-digit verification code. Use this if the original OTP has expired or was not
received.

Returns 409 if the email is already verified. Returns 404 if the email is not
registered.

email.description: The registered email address to resend the OTP to.

200.description: A new OTP has been sent to the email address.

example.message: A new OTP has been sent to your email address

data.message: A new OTP has been sent to your email address

404.description: Not found — no user with the given email.

post.description:
Authenticates a user with their email and password. On success, returns the user
profile along with new JWT access and refresh tokens. The user's `lastLoginAt`
timestamp is updated and any cached user data is invalidated.

**Important:** The user's email must be verified before they can log in.
If the email is unverified, a `403` error is returned. Use the `/resend-otp`
endpoint to request a new verification code if needed.

200.description: Login successful — returns user profile and JWT tokens.

example.message: Please verify your email address before logging in

post.description:
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new pair of access and refresh tokens.
The previous refresh token is invalidated (rotated). If the provided refresh
token is expired, tampered with, or does not match the stored token, the
request is rejected with a 401.

200.description: Token refreshed successfully — returns new access and refresh tokens.

401.description: Unauthorized — refresh token is invalid or expired.

post.description:
Changes the password for the currently authenticated user. Requires the
current password for verification. On success, a "password changed"
notification email is sent to the user.

**Requires:** Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid token or current password is incorrect.

post.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided email address for password reset.
A generic success message is always returned regardless of whether the
email exists — this prevents email enumeration attacks.

The OTP expires after **15 minutes**. Use the `/reset-password` endpoint
to verify the OTP and set a new password.

200.description: Password reset OTP sent (or generic success for non-existent emails).

example.message: Password reset OTP sent to your email address

data.message: Password reset OTP sent to your email address

post.description:
Resets the user's password using the 6-digit OTP received via the
`/forgot-password` endpoint. On success the password is updated,
all OTPs are invalidated, the refresh token is revoked, and a
"password changed" notification email is sent.

The user will need to log in again after a successful reset.

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP code from the reset email.

401.description: Unauthorized — OTP is invalid or expired.

404.description: Not found — no user with the given email.

post.summary: Upload a CAD/BIM file and start APS translation
post.description:
Accepts a multipart file upload (CAD: RVT, DWG, IFC, DXF, NWD / vector PDF).

**What happens internally:**
1. The file is uploaded to the Autodesk OSS (Object Storage Service) transient bucket.
2. A Model Derivative translation job is immediately submitted, requesting SVF2 output
   with both 2D and 3D views. This makes the element properties queryable.
3. The Base64 URL-safe URN of the file is returned. **Store this URN** — you need it
   for the status and BOQ endpoints.

Translation is asynchronous and typically takes 30 seconds to several minutes depending
on file size and complexity. Poll `GET /status/:urn` to know when it's ready.

**File size limit:** 200 MB.

file.description: CAD/BIM or vector PDF file (max 200 MB). Supported formats — RVT, DWG, DXF, IFC, NWD, PDF, DGN, SKP, OBJ, FBX.

documentHint.description: Optional free-text context about the drawing (e.g. "15-storey residential tower, Sydney"). Passed to Claude at BOQ generation time.

201.description: File uploaded and translation job started successfully.

example.message: File uploaded to APS and translation job started

400.description: No file provided or unsupported file extension.

502.description: APS authentication or OSS upload failed.

example.message: Failed to upload file to Autodesk OSS.

get.summary: Get APS translation status for a URN
get.description:
Polls the APS Model Derivative manifest and returns the current translation status.

**Statuses:**
| Status       | Meaning                                              |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `pending`    | Job queued but processing hasn't started yet.        |
| `inprogress` | Translation is running. Progress % is shown.         |
| `success`    | Translation complete — ready for BOQ generation.     |
| `failed`     | Translation error. Re-upload the file to try again.  |
| `timeout`    | Job exceeded the APS timeout threshold.              |

**Recommended polling interval:** every 5–10 seconds.
Stop polling once `status === "success"` or `status === "failed"`.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: Base64 URL-safe encoded APS URN returned by the upload endpoint.

404.description: No manifest found for this URN (file may not have been uploaded or has expired).

example.message: No manifest found for this URN. Ensure the file was translated.

post.summary: Generate a Bill of Quantities from a translated BIM model
post.description:
Runs the full property-extraction and Claude AI reasoning pipeline:

1. **Guard check** — Verifies translation status is `success`. Returns `202` if still in progress.
2. **View selection** — Retrieves the model views (e.g. 3D Structural View, Ground Floor Plan).
   The `viewIndex` parameter selects which view to use (default: 0 = first view).
3. **Property extraction** — Calls `getAllProperties` on the selected view GUID to retrieve
   every element and its attributes (Category, Dimensions, Volume, Area, Length, etc.).
4. **Filtering** — Discards elements with no dimensional data (pure annotation, tags, etc.).
   Only walls, slabs, columns, beams, doors, windows, MEP etc. with measurable properties pass.
5. **Claude reasoning** — Sends the cleaned JSON to `claude-sonnet-4` with a professional
   quantity-surveyor system prompt. Claude groups items by category, aggregates totals,
   and returns a formatted Markdown BOQ table.

**Response includes:**
- `boq` — Markdown-formatted BOQ table ready to display or export.
- `boqData` — Structured JSON, grouped by category, for programmatic use.
- `rawItemCount` / `filteredItemCount` — Transparency on how many elements were processed.

**Important:** Only call this endpoint once `GET /status/:urn` returns `status === "success"`.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: Base64 URL-safe encoded APS URN returned by the upload endpoint.

documentHint.description: Free-text project context passed to Claude (e.g. project type, region, scale). Improves BOQ accuracy for Claude.
documentHint.example: 10-storey commercial tower, Lagos, Nigeria. Concrete frame with curtain wall facade.

viewIndex.description: Index of the model view to extract properties from. 0 = first available view (usually the primary 3D view).

data.boq:
| Category | Item Description | Mark | Qty / Count | Area (m²) | Volume (m³) | Length (m) | Unit |
|...|

202.description: Translation is still in progress. Keep polling `/status/:urn`.

example.message: Translation is still in progress. Poll /status/:urn to check.

404.description: No manifest found for this URN.

422.description: Translation failed or no views found in the derivative.

example.message: APS translation job failed. Please re-upload the file.

post.summary: Submit a document for AI processing
post.description:
Uploads a previously-uploaded document for AI analysis. The system will:
1. Validate the uploaded file exists
2. Estimate and reserve credits
3. Process the document with the selected AI provider
4. Return extracted dimensions, quantities, materials, and symbols

Supported document types: floor plans, elevations, sections, structural drawings,
MEP drawings, schedules, and full skyscraper plan sets (up to 2000 pages).

uploadedFileId.description: The ID of a previously uploaded file.

documentHint.description: Optional hint about the document (e.g., "20-storey residential tower").

example.documentHint: Ground floor plan for a 15-storey commercial building
